DETECTED_HEADING: Scope of Tort Law

The main aim of implementing tort law was to use it as a tool to make people to follow the behavior of a 
reasonable prudent man and to make them respectful towards each other’s rights and duties. In order to 
achieve its aim law of torts allows the victim to claim compensation for the infringement of his right.
